package_info.why_malicious: N/A – This report does not describe a specific malicious package, but rather discusses the importance of Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs) for software supply chain security and risk management.

behavioral_signatures: Lack of SBOM disclosure in software procurement processes
Failure to provide inventory of internal and external software assets
Absence of tracking for third-party and open-source dependencies
file_indicators: No inventory files for dependencies or internal assets
network_indicators: N/A – No network indicators described in this report
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: To detect supply chain risks, organizations should require SBOM disclosure from all software vendors and verify the completeness and accuracy of the SBOM. Automated tools can be used to scan for missing or outdated SBOMs, and to cross-reference declared dependencies with actual software components. Absence of SBOMs or incomplete dependency tracking should be flagged as a risk for further investigation.
